name: Ship Phase
description: Fifth phase of the task flow (Plan → Implement → Review → Fix → Ship). Defined once in mcp-core/phase-prompts.cjs (PHASE_ORDER/PHASE_META/PHASE_DESCRIPTIONS/PHASE_PROCEDURES.ship), which also generates the /cw-ship skill (skills/cw-ship.cjs, listed in skills.cjs) and the cw-shipper agent (agents.cjs). Fix and a clean Review now hand off with phase:"ship"; the Ship session commits (Conventional Commits), pushes, creates or reuses the PR via gh, waits on `gh pr checks --watch`, records the URL in the task's optional `prUrl` field (task-format frontmatter, only serialized when set; task_create/task_update accept it) and finally clears phase and sets status done. UI: Phase Board has a Ship column; a done task with prUrl stays in Ship with a PR chip and no Start button; TaskDetailPane shows the PR link. codeWorkbench.worktrees.cleanupMerged also offers worktrees whose shipped tasks' PRs are MERGED (gh pr view --json state), with the task titles as picker detail.
guidelines: Add or change a phase ONLY in phase-prompts.cjs plus the type unions (VALID_PHASES, TaskPhase d.ts files, ui TaskPhase/COLUMNS/PHASE_FLOW, tasks-server enums).
Ship is the only phase that ends the flow: it clears `phase` and sets status done.
anti_patterns: Do not let Fix or Review clear the phase and mark done directly — they hand off to ship.
Do not patch code in the Ship phase; a failing check is a blocker.
